new_value: All 5 site groups fixed on current main (worker-2's ywec slice a348cba56e was never merged; its node.rs:387/router.rs:697 equivalents were already covered by my merged i72x.2 work, and its pinned_pubkey_for_addr duplicates my merged pinned_pubkey_for_routable - kept mine, single resolver). Fixes: (1) rpl_stack/secure.rs:143 peer_matches_destination now matches link-local IID OR pinned-key routable, next_hop = toggled peer IID (was garbage ipv6_eui64); (2) secure.rs:1139+1287 l2_destination from link-local low half or link-authenticated sender_iid; (3) stack.rs:826 wire_is_for_local_stack + rpl_stack/util.rs wire_is_for_local accept unicast to the node's routable /128 (new local_rpl_addr param, both callers); (4) ipv6_eui64 routable call sites: mod.rs:270 root first-hop + receive.rs:385 SRH forwarding resolve via peer_iid_for_routable_addr (fail closed: no route / RplRejected), util.rs:447 SRH anti-loop now exact-compares sender link-local AND routable (new sender_routable param from the link-authenticated frame), rpl_stack/secure.rs:150 covered by (1); (5) lichen-rpl assemble_path_from (wuio item 5) is the design-blocked parent-forms issue - stays with worker6-nnmc + worker6-plqy (spec decision), test three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent remains red for it. Also fixed node.rs:409 garbage-IID pin lookup (false-binding hazard, ywec-slice equivalent) and the binding_invariant->binding_invariant_rejected stale match in lichen-core/tests/ipv6_address_vectors.rs. Tests: lichen-node 358/1 (only the tracked nnmc failure - same as baseline), lichen-rpl green, lichen-core 3/4 (remaining failure is the corpus contradiction filed as new P1 bead - q6ko.3 scope lost in store corruption). Clippy clean on touched crates (pre-existing unused-import warning in untouched lichen-rpl/src/srh.rs:8 left alone). 3x codereview: delegation timed out at 900s x3 (3rd consecutive round - reviewer infra down), passes done inline per documented fallback: correctness/security/edge-cases all PASS, zero findings.
